caption: The drawing is composed of three outlined sketches of a sleeveless garment, likely a child's top or bib, rendered in fine pencil lines on a beige or off-white background. The main and largest sketch in the center shows a frontal view of the garment, which has wide shoulder straps fastened with a button on each side, and is bordered throughout by a ruffled trim. Two smaller sketches appear above right and below center. The top right sketch presents the garment from the back, also with ruffled borders and visible seam lines. The bottom sketch shows a detached view of the same garment, highlighting the U-shape and ruffle trim along the edges. All lines are fine and delicate, and the drawing is lightly shaded, featuring no colors besides the soft gray of the pencil. The name “E. GAUSSER” is inscribed at the bottom right.
title: Baby's Bib
